spec.title: Container CPU usage, % of one core

spec.expr:

sum by (phase, target_rps, operation_type) (
  rate(k6_http_reqs_total{

spec.title: HTTP requests/sec by route and status

spec.expr:
label_replace(
  1000 *
  sum(
    rate(traces_spanmetrics_duration_seconds_sum{
      job="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
      service_name="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
      span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",
      db_system="postgresql"
    }[$__rate_interval])
  )
  /
  sum(
    rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{
      job="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
      service_name="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
      span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",
      http_route="api/v1/vehicles/<int:vehicle_id>/trip-points/"
    }[$__rate_interval])
  ),
  "component",
  "SQL",
  "__name__",
  ".*"
)
or
label_replace(
  1000 *
  sum(
    rate(traces_spanmetrics_duration_seconds_sum{
      job="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
      service_name="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
      span_kind="SPAN_KIND_INTERNAL",
      span_name!="RequestTraceLoggingMiddleware.__call__"
    }[$__rate_interval])
  )
  /
  sum(
    rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{
      job="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
      service_name="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
      span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",
      http_route="api/v1/vehicles/<int:vehicle_id>/trip-points/"
    }[$__rate_interval])
  ),
  "component",
  "Measured non-SQL",
  "__name__",
  ".*"
)
or
label_replace(
  1000 *
  clamp_min(
    (
      sum(
        rate(traces_spanmetrics_duration_seconds_sum{
          job="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
          service_name="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
          span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",
          http_route="api/v1/vehicles/<int:vehicle_id>/trip-points/"
        }[$__rate_interval])
      )
      -
      sum(
        rate(traces_spanmetrics_duration_seconds_sum{
          job="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
          service_name="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
          span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT",
          db_system="postgresql"
        }[$__rate_interval])
      )
      -
      sum(
        rate(traces_spanmetrics_duration_seconds_sum{
          job="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
          service_name="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
          span_kind="SPAN_KIND_INTERNAL",
          span_name!="RequestTraceLoggingMiddleware.__call__"
        }[$__rate_interval])
      )
    )
    /
    sum(
      rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{
        job="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
        service_name="taxi-manager-django-wsgi",
        span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",
        http_route="api/v1/vehicles/<int:vehicle_id>/trip-points/"
      }[$__rate_interval])
    ),
    0
  ),
  "component",
  "Unmeasured",
  "__name__",
  ".*"
)
